title: [feat]/ Save and reopen complete native production and DJ projects
problem: A producer cannot commit work to a product that reconstructs the demo on every launch. Native project persistence is missing.
evidence: Audited baseline: https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/src/engine/mod.rs#L365 and https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/Cargo.toml. This capability is absent or materially narrower in the current command model, UI and dependency graph.
Benchmark/reference: https://www.ableton.com/en/live-manual/12/managing-files-and-sets/. Requirements below are proposed Omatainer behavior, not a claim of identical vendor implementation.
acceptance: Provide New, Open, Open Recent, Save, Save As and Save Copy with dirty-state and unsaved-change handling.
Round-trip tracks, clips, notes, automation, routing, devices, plugin state, decks, sample references, mappings and view state without lossy reconstruction.
Use an explicitly versioned format with compatibility checks, atomic replacement and understandable validation errors.
Reopening in a fresh process reproduces project state and reference rendering; an interrupted save preserves the previous good file.
validation: Exercise the workflow through the shipped UI, persist/reopen applicable state, and test cancellation and failure paths. Record the actual supported platform and fixture results.

evidence: Audited baseline: https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/src/engine/mod.rs#L365 and https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/Cargo.toml. This capability is absent or materially narrower in the current command model, UI and dependency graph.
Benchmark/reference: https://help.ableton.com/hc/en-us/articles/209773265-Troubleshooting-a-crash. Requirements below are proposed Omatainer behavior, not a claim of identical vendor implementation.
acceptance: Collect bounded logs, engine/backend versions, routing and performance counters with explicit redaction.
Allow users to inspect contents and opt in before any upload.
Associate crash reports with recoverable projects and safe-mode launch options.
Validate reports from simulated audio, plugin, parser and storage failures without attaching original media by default.
validation: Exercise the workflow through the shipped UI, persist/reopen applicable state, and test cancellation and failure paths. Record the actual supported platform and fixture results.

title: [feat]/ Deliver verified releases with safe updates and rollback

evidence: Audited baseline: https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/src/engine/mod.rs#L365 and https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/Cargo.toml. Professional-readiness requirement inferred from the combined producer/live-DJ brief; not asserted to be a bundled feature of either reference product.
acceptance: Publish versioned packages/checksums, supported system requirements and migration notes.
Install/update atomically with rollback and defer all updates in performance mode.
Preserve projects, configuration and plugin compatibility across supported upgrades.
Exercise clean install, upgrade, failed update and rollback locally on supported systems.
validation: Exercise the workflow through the shipped UI, persist/reopen applicable state, and test cancellation and failure paths. Record the actual supported platform and fixture results.

title: [feat]/ Preserve and qualify offline operation as optional online features arrive
problem: The current demo and local-file application already run locally. Preserve that behavior as project persistence, plugin hosting, providers and optional cloud transfer are added; the missing deliverable is an explicit tested offline-support contract, not removal of a present login gate.
evidence: Current local baseline starts directly without network authentication: https://github.com/michaelmonetized/omatainer/blob/cae546c7bc840ec1a643e4befe18f91e86d0e4c7/src/main.rs#L13-L37 . This issue protects and qualifies existing local behavior across planned integrations.
Professional-readiness requirement inferred from the combined producer/live-DJ brief; not asserted to be a bundled feature of either reference product.
acceptance: Make local media, projects, plugins and documentation usable without a cloud session.
Isolate optional network integrations and expose their offline/cache restrictions honestly.
Keep credentials in an appropriate secret store and never embed them in projects/support bundles.
Validate cold startup and a full performance with network access disabled.
validation: Exercise the workflow through the shipped UI, persist/reopen applicable state, and test cancellation and failure paths. Record the actual supported platform and fixture results.
